source.name: BASC-Archiver: 4chan /wsr/ board (Jan 6, 2016)
source.short-desc: An archive of 4chan's /wsr/ board as of January 6, 2016.
source.capture: BASC-Archiver output, 1944 threads of /wsr/ staged as out/wsr/<threadno>/<threadno>.{json,html}. It saves BOTH the rendered HTML and the thread's 4chan JSON API response, so json-api reads it and no HTML adapter is needed — an earlier note here claimed 'No JSON', which was wrong. Each thread dir also holds css/, js/, images/ and thumbs/ that ingest ignores. Timestamps are the API's real UTC epochs, not displayed wall time.
